text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The ruling MPLA party said in a three-quarter page statement that it is prepared to go along with the planned installation of the government of national unity, but has urged that the remaining problems such as integration of UNITA military and police move forward quickly.
- The U.N. special representative to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, met on Tuesday the UNITA deputies due to take up their seats in the National Assembly next week.
